name: Light Cycles
hook: Your trail is a wall. Last rider wins.
how: Every rider leaves a glowing wall behind it. Turn to cut the others off. Touch any wall or the edge and you are out. The last rider still going wins the round.
controls: Arrow keys or A/D to turn, or tap the left or right side of the screen
uses: Rounds won, all time, shown after every round.
One player's browser runs the countdown, the winner and the bots; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the arena until enough people join.
Every cycle and every wall shows for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a jump with a cooldown
Make it a desert at sunset with sand-colored trails
